<div class="card-body">
'''Probe Droid Laser''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">プローブ・ドロイド・レーザー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のプローブ・ドロイドに配備する。フォースを消費せずに起動する。運命数を引く。目標がキャラクターなら運命数＞能力値で命中する。目標が固定兵器なら運命数＞5で即座にロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Probe-Droid-Laser-PSA-88099887.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">プローブ・ドロイドは相手に見つからないことを第1とするが、多くのモデルにはレーザーを装備することができ、戦闘力や秘密工作活動の能力を向上させられる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Probe Droid Laser.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any Probe Droid. Activate without spending Force. Draw destiny. A character target is hit if destiny is greater than ability. An artillery weapon target is immediately lost if destiny is greater than 5.

'''Lore:'''
A probe droid’s first concern is not being found, but many models can mount a laser, improving combat power and sabotage ability.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 個人用兵器, not Character Weapon.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Probe Droid Laser]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
